# bcdec

`bcdec.h` v0.985 from [iOrange/bcdec](https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec),
commit `80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c`.
Used under the MIT license in `LICENSE`; the header also offers the Unlicense.
